svg.title: Five 5×5 Brian2 topologies with fault targets
svg.desc: Diagrams of chain-of-chains, funnel, highway, binary tree, and hourglass topologies
svg.text: 5 independent horizontal chains — zero cross-row connections
All drivers feed one hub; hub fans out to all outputs
Row-2 trunk carries all signal; other rows on-ramp in
Each node has exactly one parent — cleanest ground truth
Single bottleneck bridge — cutting it silences all 10 right-half nodes
